You are building the CUSTOMER PORTAL pages for Nxeon, a premium VPS hosting platform (Next.js 15 App Router + Prisma + Tailwind v4) at /opt/nxeon. The design system, layouts, actions, and APIs already exist — your job is ONLY to write page/component files. Read /opt/nxeon/CLAUDE.md first.

STRICT FILE BOUNDARIES — you may ONLY create/edit files under:
- /opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/** (EXCEPT app/dashboard/layout.tsx — do not touch)
- /opt/nxeon/components/customer/** (new client components go here)
Do NOT touch: lib/, worker/, prisma/, app/admin, app/api, app/globals.css, components/ui/, components/portal/, any config files. Do NOT run npm run build, npm install, git, or systemctl — the orchestrator handles builds and deploys.

EXISTING FOUNDATION (import these, don't reinvent):
- Design tokens/classes in app/globals.css: .card, .card-hover, .glass, .btn-primary/.btn-secondary/.btn-danger/.btn-ghost, .input, .label, .page-title, .section-label, .grad-text, .table-shell, .kbd, .skeleton, colors navy-950/900/850/800/700, brand-300..600, accent-blue. Dark premium theme; glassmorphism; rounded-2xl cards.
- components/ui/primitives.tsx: PageHeader, StatCard (label,value,delta,spark,icon,href), StatusDot, Badge, EmptyState, ComingSoon, fmtBytes, fmtMoney, timeAgo
- components/ui/charts.tsx: Sparkline, AreaChart (series:[{name,data,color}], id, yLabel, xLabels, maxY), Donut, MeterBar
- components/StatusBadge.tsx, components/AutoRefresh.tsx (refreshes page every 5s — include on pages showing transitional states), components/ServerControls.tsx (power/reinstall/delete buttons), components/SubscriptionControls.tsx (RenewalCard), components/OrderForm.tsx (legacy — replace with your own deploy wizard), components/BillingForms.tsx (TopUpForm — legacy demo; build your own that calls POST /api/stripe/checkout {amount} → redirect to json.url, falling back to the demo topUp action from lib/actions when checkout returns an error).
- Server actions (import from "@/lib/actions"): orderServer(prev, formData) [fields: planId, osTemplateId, hostname, optional free="1" for admins], serverAction(serverId, action: start|stop|reboot|reinstall|delete), topUp(prev, formData), toggleAutoRenew(serverId), renewNow(serverId)
- From "@/lib/actions-account": updateProfile, changePassword, addSshKey(prev, fd: name, publicKey), deleteSshKey(id), createProject(prev, fd: name, color), deleteProject(id), assignServerProject(serverId, projectId|null)
- From "@/lib/actions-server": createSnapshot(serverId, name), deleteSnapshot(serverId, name), rollbackSnapshot(serverId, name), createBackup(serverId), resizeServer(serverId, planId), addPortForward(prev, fd: serverId, guestPort, protocol), deletePortForward(serverId, forwardId)
- From "@/lib/actions-support": createTicket(prev, fd: subject, body, priority), replyTicket(prev, fd: ticketId, body), setTicketStatus(ticketId, "OPEN"|"CLOSED")
- From "@/lib/actions-domains": purchaseDomain(prev, fd: domain + registrant contact fields firstName,lastName,address1,city,stateProvince,postalCode,country,phone(+1.5551234567 format),email), renewDomainAction(domainId), toggleDomainAutoRenew(domainId), addDnsRecord(prev, fd: domainId,name,type,address,ttl,mxPref), deleteDnsRecord(domainId, {name,type,address}), pointDomainAtServer(domainId)
- From "@/lib/auth": currentUser(), requireUser() — server components use requireUser(); pages already sit under an authed layout.
- From "@/lib/db": db (PrismaClient). Schema: User(balanceCents, role), Plan(slug,name,cpuCores,ramMB,diskGB,bandwidthTB,priceCents,active,sortOrder), OsTemplate(slug,name,vmid,active), Server(id,name,hostname,vmid,status[PENDING|PROVISIONING|RUNNING|STOPPED|SUSPENDED|REINSTALLING|DELETING|ERROR],ipAddress,sshPort,rootPassword,isFree,autoRenew,suspendedNote,expiresAt,projectId,userId,planId,osTemplateId,portForwards[],jobs[]), PortForward(publicPort,guestPort,protocol), Job(type,status[QUEUED|RUNNING|DONE|FAILED],error,createdAt), WalletTransaction(amountCents,description,createdAt), Project(name,color,servers), SshKey(name,publicKey), Ticket(subject,status[OPEN|ANSWERED|CUSTOMER_REPLY|CLOSED],priority,messages), TicketMessage(body,isStaff,author,createdAt), Notification, Domain(name,status[PENDING|ACTIVE|FAILED|EXPIRED],priceCents,autoRenew,registeredAt,expiresAt), AuditLog(action,detail,createdAt)
- From "@/lib/proxmox": vmStatus(vmid) → {cpu,mem,maxmem,disk,maxdisk,uptime,netin,netout,status}, listSnapshots(vmid), listBackups(vmid). Wrap ALL pve calls in try/catch — the API can be briefly unavailable.
- GET /api/metrics?serverId=X&tf=hour|day|week|month → {data:[{time,cpu,mem,maxmem,netin,netout,disk,maxdisk}]} (rrd time series; values may be null — filter). Env PUBLIC_IP is the host public IP.

CONVENTIONS: server components by default with `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`. Client components ("use client") only for interactivity; useActionState for form actions with {error} returns; useTransition for button actions. Money via fmtMoney. Dates via .toISOString().slice(0,10) or timeAgo. Every page: PageHeader + refined empty states. NO fake/mock data anywhere — every number must come from Prisma or the Proxmox helpers. Async page params are Promise ({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }).

BUILD THESE PAGES (replace existing where present):

1. app/dashboard/page.tsx — Dashboard overview like a premium cloud console: StatCard row (Total servers, Running, Monthly spend = sum of non-free servers' plan price, Wallet balance with Add-funds link); server list table (hostname → link, StatusDot, plan specs, IP:port, quick Manage link); recent activity feed from AuditLog (user's own, last 8, timeAgo); recent transactions mini-list; "Deploy server" primary CTA; if user has zero servers show a beautiful EmptyState hero. Include AutoRefresh only if any server transitional.

2. app/dashboard/servers/page.tsx — full server list with search-less simple filter chips by status (client component), each row: status, hostname, project badge (colored dot from project.color), specs, IP/SSH, created, Manage.

3. app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx + components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx — THE flagship page. Header: hostname, StatusDot, plan + OS badges, free badge, ServerControls. Tab bar (client, URL ?tab= param): Overview | Metrics | Snapshots | Backups | Networking | Resize | Activity. Content is passed as named ReactNode props into ServerTabs (server component fetches everything, client component only switches tabs).
   - Overview: access card (SSH command `ssh root@PUBLIC_IP -p sshPort`, root password with click-to-reveal client comp, private IP), live vmStatus stats (CPU%, mem used/max via MeterBar, uptime, net io), config card (specs, created, renews), RenewalCard (if !isFree), project assignment select (client, assignServerProject with user's projects).
   - Metrics: components/customer/MetricsPanel.tsx client component — fetches /api/metrics?serverId&tf with timeframe pills (1h/24h/7d/30d), renders AreaChart for CPU % (cpu*100), Memory (mem/1e9 GB with maxY maxmem/1e9), Network (netin/netout KB/s), auto-refresh every 30s. Filter null entries.
   - Snapshots: list via listSnapshots(vmid) (name, snaptime date, description), create form (name input), rollback + delete buttons with confirm dialogs; note "snapshots live on the same storage; use backups for disaster recovery". All via actions; show {error} inline.
   - Backups: listBackups(vmid) → volid tail as name, ctime date, size fmtBytes; "Create backup" button (createBackup); note stored on separate 4TB pool.
   - Networking: SSH forward row (readonly), port forward table (public :port → guest :port/proto), add form (guestPort, protocol select), delete buttons; explain NAT: connect to PUBLIC_IP:publicPort.
   - Resize: current plan highlighted; grid of other active plans (disable ones with smaller disk, tooltip why); confirm + resizeServer; note "resize requires a power cycle, price changes at next renewal".
   - Activity: server's jobs (type, StatusDot, attempts, error if failed, created) + AuditLogs with detail containing server id — just jobs is fine.
   Include AutoRefresh when transitional/queued jobs exist.

4. app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx + components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx — 3-step wizard (client): 1) Choose OS (logo-ish cards) + plan (cards with specs/price, recommended badge on middle), 2) hostname + project select + note about SSH keys auto-injection (link Settings), 3) Review order: itemized (plan monthly price, due today, wallet balance after; admins get a "free deployment" toggle). Submit → orderServer. Progress indicator; back/next; validate hostname regex ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$ client-side. Keep app/dashboard/order/page.tsx as a redirect() to /dashboard/deploy.

5. app/dashboard/projects/page.tsx — project cards (name, color dot, server count, servers listed inside with status), create form (name + color input type=color), delete (only when empty — check server count, else show hint).

6. app/dashboard/domains/page.tsx + components/customer/DomainSearch.tsx — domain portfolio table (name, status, expires, autoRenew toggle, manage link) + hero search: client comp calls GET /api/domains/check?q= (debounced), shows availability list with prices (priceCents) and "Register" button linking to /dashboard/domains/register?domain=X. If API returns configured:false show an elegant notice "Domain registration activates once the Namecheap integration is configured" (still show the search box disabled).

7. app/dashboard/domains/register/page.tsx — registration form: domain from searchParam (searchParams is Promise too), price summary, registrant contact form (all purchaseDomain fields, country ISO-2 select of ~20 common countries, phone format hint), wallet balance check display, submit purchaseDomain.

8. app/dashboard/domains/[id]/page.tsx — domain management: status/dates/autorenew card with renewDomainAction + toggleDomainAutoRenew; "Point at my server" one-click button (pointDomainAtServer) with explanation; DNS records manager: table of records via getDnsHosts from "@/lib/namecheap" (import server-side, wrap try/catch; if it throws show error state), add-record form (type select A/AAAA/CNAME/TXT/MX/NS, name, value, TTL, mxPref when MX), delete per row (deleteDnsRecord).

9. app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx — balance hero card with gradient; Add funds: client comp → POST /api/stripe/checkout, on {url} redirect window.location; if error contains "not configured" fall back to showing demo topUp form with a subtle "demo gateway" note. Monthly spend summary (sum plan prices of non-free servers + upcoming renewals list with dates); transaction table (invoice-style, +/- colored); banner if ?paid=1 ("Payment received — balance updates within seconds") or ?canceled=1.

10. app/dashboard/support/page.tsx — ticket list (subject, StatusDot, priority Badge, updated timeAgo) + "New ticket" slide-down form (subject, priority select, message). app/dashboard/support/[id]/page.tsx — conversation thread (customer right-aligned brand bubbles, staff left glass bubbles, timestamps), reply box, close/reopen button.

11. app/dashboard/activity/page.tsx — user's AuditLog timeline (vertical line + dots, action label humanized, detail, timeAgo) + their WalletTransactions merged chronologically is NOT needed — just audit log.

12. app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx — sections: Profile (updateProfile), Password (changePassword), SSH keys (list with fingerprint-ish truncated key, add form name+publicKey textarea, delete; note "keys are injected into new servers automatically"), API access section: ComingSoon component.

Quality bar: consistent spacing (space-y-6 between cards), all interactive states, no dead links (only link to routes listed here), TypeScript strict-safe (no implicit any; Prisma types inferred). Verify each file compiles logically — matching imports/exports, "use server" actions imported into client components only via the action props pattern shown (they're already "use server" files, direct import is fine).

When done, report: list of files created, any deviations, and anything you couldn't complete.

1	# Nxeon — VPS hosting platform
2	
3	Hostinger-style VPS hosting platform running on this Proxmox VE 9 dedicated server (OVH KS-GAME, i7-7700K, 64GB RAM, 2×450GB NVMe ZFS mirror + 4TB HDD backup pool).
4	
5	## Architecture
6	
7	- **Web panel**: Next.js 15 (App Router, server actions) + Tailwind v4, served by `nxeon-web.service` on port 3000, behind nginx on port 80. Public IP: 51.79.162.96.
8	- **Worker**: `worker/index.ts` run by `nxeon-worker.service` (as root — it manages iptables). Polls the `Job` table every 3s and executes provisioning/lifecycle jobs against the Proxmox API.
9	- **DB**: PostgreSQL 17, database `nxeon`, Prisma ORM ([prisma/schema.prisma](prisma/schema.prisma)). Use `npm run db:push` after schema changes.
10	- **Proxmox**: API token auth (`nxeon@pve!platform`, creds in `.env`). Templates: VMID 9000 (Ubuntu 24.04), 9001 (Debian 13), cloud-init based, cloned onto ZFS storage `vmdata`.
11	- **Networking**: VMs attach to NAT bridge `vmbr1` (10.20.0.0/24, gateway .1). IPs allocated from 10.20.0.100–250 ([lib/ipam.ts](lib/ipam.ts)). SSH exposed via DNAT port forwards 20000–29999 in iptables chain `NXEON_FWD`, rebuilt from DB by [worker/network.ts](worker/network.ts) — never edit that chain by hand.
12	- **Cloud-init**: vendor snippet at `/tank/backup/snippets/nxeon-vendor.yaml` (installs qemu-guest-agent, enables root password SSH).
13	
14	## Conventions
15	
16	- All state changes to VMs go through `Job` rows — the web app never calls Proxmox mutation endpoints directly (read-only status calls are OK).
17	- One in-flight job per server (enforced in `serverAction`).
18	- Admin-only actions live in [lib/actions.ts](lib/actions.ts) and must call `requireAdmin()`.
19	- Free VPSes: `Server.isFree = true`, no billing, `expiresAt = null`.
20	- Wallet amounts are integer cents.
21	
22	## Commands
23	
24	- Build: `npm run build` (must pass before restarting services)
25	- Deploy after changes: `npm run build && systemctl restart nxeon-web nxeon-worker`
26	- Worker logs: `journalctl -u nxeon-worker -f`
27	- E2E test: `npx tsx scripts/e2e-test.ts` (orders a real VM; delete it afterwards via a DELETE job)
28	- Admin credentials: `/root/nxeon-credentials.txt`
29	
30	## Safety rules
31	
32	- NEVER touch VMIDs 9000–9999 (templates) except to add new templates.
33	- Never `qm destroy` a VM that has a `Server` row — always go through a DELETE job.
34	- Do not commit `.env`. Do not print the Proxmox token into logs or docs.
35	- Always `git commit` working states; never leave the tree broken — services restart from this directory.
